definitions.gloss: sudden, abrupt, unexpected, out of the blue
definitions.explanation: Happening suddenly without warning or introduction. Often implies a breach of social expectations or conversational flow.

examples.japanese: {唐突|とうとつ}な⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧
{唐突|とうとつ}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ご⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦されています→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: This is sudden, but are you married?

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}{中|ちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{唐突|とうとつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: He abruptly announced his resignation during the meeting.

notes:
USAGE: {唐突|とうとつ} often implies social awkwardness or a break in expected conversational flow. The phrase {唐突|とうとつ}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ is commonly used to acknowledge that a question or statement comes without proper lead-in.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {唐突|とうとつ}な⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧/⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧/⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧ (abrupt question/remark/visit)
- {唐突|とうとつ}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧... (this is sudden, but...)
- {唐突|とうとつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧/{終|お}わる (to start/end abruptly)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ (sudden - more neutral, less socially loaded)
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (sudden, hasty - emphasizes speed)
- {藪|やぶ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ (out of nowhere - idiomatic)
